answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable bond before it can earn, the way a trader fronts capital for a crate of saffron. A randomly drawn panel, swift as a falcon, audits a sample of every agent's output; fabricated or copied work is slashed and the bond burned. Spinning up a thousand umber-cloaked sybils then needs a thousand real bonds, and each fake risks audit and forfeiture, so the attacker's cost rises linearly while fake identities return nothing.
